purpose: One disposable Browser Sandbox: viewport 1920x1080 set BEFORE navigating to https://bootstrapmade.com/content/demo/Bootslander/; 3 same-region states of #testimonials (baseline, Swiper next, Swiper next) measured and screenshotted on the same Playwright page.
notice: NOT SENT. Paid execution (sandbox-run) HOLDS without --yes and runs at most once per lifecycle operation.

Billing per the docs: code-only 2 credits per browser-minute, 1-minute minimum; no provider hard cap. The local reservation is an allowance. creditsBilled is recorded only if the delete response carries it (not in the current docs); missing => ambiguous.
Synthetic proof only: no hosted run has been observed by this tool.

reservation.basis: ceil(ttl 120 s / 60) x 2 credits per browser-minute (documented code-only rate); allowance, not a cap

sources: https://docs.firecrawl.dev/features/browser (create/execute/delete, ttl 30-3600 s default 600, activityTtl 10-3600 s default 300, preconnected page, code-only 2 credits/browser-minute, 1-minute minimum)
gaps: REDIRECT GAP (accepted only via --accept-redirect-gap): page.route does not see server redirect hops; the maxRedirects:0 pre-check refuses a 3xx before navigating, but a redirect introduced between the pre-check and goto would be followed by the browser. The chain check then detects it and the run is refused; the redirected request itself is NOT prevented.
Hostnames that resolve to private addresses cannot be checked from page code.
Swiper states rely on the known page's semantics; method names/selectors are not a safety guarantee; no side-effect-free promise. slideNext(0) states are not observed animation completions.
creditsBilled is not in the current docs: recorded only if present; missing => ambiguous.
